1.name: red square
1.description: The large red square. It fills most of the upper right of the painting and is by far the biggest shape.

2.name: blue rectangle
2.description: A blue rectangle in the bottom left corner, deep and bright.

3.name: yellow rectangle
3.description: A small yellow rectangle in the bottom right corner, the smallest block of color in the painting.

4.name: white rectangle
4.description: A white rectangle in the top left corner, tall and narrow.

5.name: white rectangle
5.description: A white rectangle on the left side, in the middle, between the top left white block and the blue block below.

6.name: white rectangle
6.description: A long white rectangle along the bottom, in the middle, under the red square.

7.name: white rectangle
7.description: A small white rectangle on the right edge, just above the yellow block.

8.name: black line
8.description: A thick black line. Straight black lines divide the painting into rectangles, crossing only at right angles.
